decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting draws directly on the firm's deep knowledge of robust, standards-compliant specialist lighting, so it can learn from naval customer feedback and keep refining the line.

The microprismatic pendant is a flagship that builds on the firm's own optics research and testing facilities and fits its push toward efficient, glare-free, human-centric lighting, so management keeps investing in it.

The HMI searchlight uses the firm's marine expertise and still serves specialist demand, but HMI technology conflicts with the LED direction, and the related marine searchlight (F) was already withdrawn, so phase-out risk is rising.
